examples.sql: SELECT DATE('2000-01-01 00:00:00') AS StringToDate -- Display Mode: 01/01/2000

SELECT GETDATE() AS GetDateCol, DATE(GETDATE()) AS DateCol
SELECT '2022-05-22 13:14:23' AS DateStrCol, DATE('2022-05-22 13:14:23') AS DateCol
SELECT TO_POSIXTIME('2022-05-22','YYYY-MM-DD') AS PosixCol, DATE(TO_POSIXTIME('2022-05-22','YYYY-MM-DD')) AS DateCol
SELECT $H AS HoroCol, DATE(+$H) AS DateCol
SELECT $ZTIMESTAMP AS TSCol, DATE(+$ZTIMESTAMP) AS DateCol
SELECT {fn NOW} AS NowCol, DATE({fn NOW}) AS DateCol
